pli-tv-bi-vb-pc57:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhuniyo gāmakāvāse vassaṃ vutthā sāvatthiṃ agamaṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc57:1.7: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti, khīyanti, vipācenti::
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc57:1.8: “kathaṃ hi nāma: bhikkhuniyo vassaṃ vutthā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ nappavāressantī”ti. …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc57:1.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhu yo vassaṃ vutthā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ nappavārentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc57:1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma: bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo vassaṃ vutthā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ nappavāressanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc57:1.14: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu::
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc57:1.15.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī vassaṃ vutthā ubhato saṅghe tīhi ṭhānehi nappavāreyya diṭṭhena vā sutena vā parisaṃkāya vā pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc57:2.1.6: purimaṃ vā temāsaṃ pacchimaṃ vā temāsaṃ vutthā
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc57:2.1.7: ubhatosaṅghe tīhi ṭhānehi nappavāressāmi diṭṭhena vā sutena vā parisaṅkāya vāti dhuraṃ nikkhittamatte āpatti pācittiyassa.
